items.title: Courtland Sutton: Team-high 46 rec yards in comeback win
items.description:
Sutton caught three of seven targets for 46 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Doesn't do much with 17 carries
items.description:
Dobbins rushed 17 times for 49 yards while catching one of two targets for four yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

items.title: RJ Harvey: Seven targets, two carries in Week 3
items.description:
Harvey (hamstring) rushed twice for six yards while catching six of seven targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Blake Corum: Limited workload during SNF
items.description:
Corum rushed six times for 15 yards and caught two of four targets for no gain during Sunday night's 30-26 loss to Denver.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bo Nix: Three totals TDs in second-half comeback
items.description: Nix completed 17 of 34 passes for 186 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams. He also rushed four times for seven yards and a touchdown in addition to throwing two successful two-point conversions.
